999008199.text:
……本は読み終わったようであるが、
人を操るような陰陽術はありそうでござるか？

localizations.en: ...You've finished reading the book, but did you find any onmyoji arts that could control people?

999008199.text:
少なくとも、俺の知る範囲にはなさそうだ。
だが、そのような術がないとも言い切れない

localizations.en: At least not in my knowledge. But I can't say for certain that such arts don't exist.

999008199.text:
なあ鬼門。コウセンの陰陽師としての実力は
調べによると、どのくらいなんだい？

localizations.en: Hey Kimon, based on your investigation, how skilled is Kosen as an onmyoji?

999008199.text:
あくまで調べではござるが、
永遠より実力があるかもしれませぬ

localizations.en: From what I've gathered, he might be even more skilled than you.

999008199.text:
コウセンの陰陽術は、
一度に多くの式神を広範囲に展開するもので――

localizations.en: Kosen's onmyoji arts involve deploying many shikigami across wide areas simultaneously—

999008199.text:
環境を整えれば、もっと大がかりなこともできると
聞いたでござる

localizations.en: I've heard that with the right conditions, he could accomplish even greater feats.

999008199.text:
一度に多くの式神を広範囲に……それは人間離れした
力を持っているな。俺より上だと判断されても仕方ない

localizations.en: Deploying many shikigami across wide areas... That's inhuman power. I can see why he'd be considered superior to me.

999008199.text:
……だが、それだけの力を持つ陰陽師なら、
他者の思考に影響を与える術も使えるかもしれない

localizations.en: ...But an onmyoji with that kind of power might also be able to use arts that influence others' thoughts.

999008199.text:
できるかもしれぬが……
そんなの、見たことも聞いたこともありませぬ

localizations.en: He might be able to, but... I've never seen or heard of such a thing.

999008199.text:
昔話や言い伝えで、妖怪に思考を操られたり、
意識を乗っ取られる話がありまするが――

localizations.en: There are old tales and legends of people having their thoughts controlled by demons or their consciousness overtaken—

999008199.text:
そのどれも、元の人格から離れたものに変化していて、
はたから見て怪しいとすぐに気付ける様子だったはず

localizations.en: But in all those stories, the person changes so drastically from their original personality that anyone could tell something was wrong just by looking.

999008199.text:
ですが、鏑矢様はあくまで鏑矢様のままで、
その人格や容姿に大きな変化や違和感はありませぬ

localizations.en: However, Lady Kaburaya is still herself. There's no major change in her personality or appearance that would raise suspicion.

999008199.text:
確かに昔話や言い伝えではそうだが、
コウセンの陰陽術はそうじゃないかもしれない

localizations.en: That's true in old tales and legends, but maybe Kosen's onmyoji arts work differently.

999008199.text:
たとえば、鏑矢の好戦的な面のみを強くする、とか、
対象を強く信頼させる、とかできるかも……

localizations.en: For instance, he might be able to enhance only Kaburaya's warlike tendencies, or make her trust him implicitly...

999008199.text:
ここまで色々言ったけれど、
どれも俺の妄想で確かな証拠はないんだけれどね

localizations.en: I've said a lot, but it's all just speculation on my part. I don't have any solid proof.

999008199.text:
それにこれが事実だったとしても、俺の今の実力じゃ、
対抗手段は何も取れないかもしれないけれど……

localizations.en: And even if this were true, with my current abilities, I might not be able to do anything to counter it...

999008199.text:
拙者の忍術でも、きっと無理でござる……
忍術には、思考に作用するような術はない故……

localizations.en: My ninjutsu wouldn't work either... Ninja arts don't include techniques that affect the mind...

999008199.text: あっ！
ど、どうした！？

ありまする！
コウセンの陰陽術に対抗できるかもしれない術！

localizations.en: There is something! An art that might be able to counter Kosen's onmyoji techniques!

999008199.text: 錬金術にござる！
